comments: In-browser tool powered by axe-core; no data leaves the client. Bookmarklet included for live-page scanning.
features: A free, in-browser accessibility checker. Paste HTML to scan it for WCAG 2.2 A/AA violations with axe-core, or use the bookmarklet to check any live page. Everything runs client-side — nothing is uploaded, no signup, no install. Results list each violation with the affected element.
title: A11yPath Accessibility Checker
